name: 概括二次元厚涂
prompt: Create ONE portrait 2:3 fantasy playing-card BACK. Input 1 fixes the composition: two golden koi curling in opposite directions around a small black square coin-hole with a jade bead, sweeping wine-red silk tails, a closed continuous rectangular red-and-gold border on all four sides and four visible folded corner knots. Input 2 is the original NAI draft for the same subject; preserve its koi, brocade, coin-hole and jade motif. Keep the proportions, fish count, circular flow and enclosing border from Input 1. The aim is a deliberate new STYLE candidate for 富商锦缎, not new subject matter. STYLE A — simplified hand-painted anime color design. Inputs 3 and 4 are style references only, especially their coherent large quiet cloth planes and wide curved brush construction; do not copy characters. Drastically reduce the existing artwork's fragmented pale scratches and dabs. Each fish body is built from only 3 or 4 substantial connected opaque gold planes; one crisp black eye and very few fin marks. Silk forms only a few long broad crimson sweeps with decisive shadow turns. The border has large smooth quiet matte red bands, broad gold corner planes and a few intentional handmade edge changes. Keep 70 percent of interiors calm, with brush marks used selectively to explain shape. Bold clear silhouettes, grouped hard-edged light and shadow, a few concentrated accents. No fish scales, no decorative line networks, no all-over mottling, grain, paper texture, dry scratch filter, tiny facets, photorealism or glossy rendering. No people, letters, logos, numbers, watermark, UI, tabletop or card mockup. The single artwork fills the whole canvas. All four border sides must remain complete and clearly separate the center picture from the edge.
